name: writer-agent
description: 基于内置 PI 的独立写作客户端：今日头条与番茄长篇，保留 DSH 存量兼容

scripts.test:node: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-test-components.mjs && node --test --import ./test/setup.mjs test/*.test.mjs test/engine/*.test.mjs
scripts.desktop:build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @writer/desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:build && npm run pack -w @writer/desktop
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run desktop:build && npm run pack:portable -w @writer/desktop
scripts.verify: npm run guard && npm run audit:exports && npm run test:py && npm run test:node
scripts.verify:desktop: npm run desktop:build && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:desktop:ui
